items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked/private, and permit only existing read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish public or commercial redistribution rights; launch-readiness is 0 of 4 tasks closed; accuracy, security, privacy, retention, vendor, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner/consent, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow and revenue is partial aggregate; $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 remains unattributed. Human counsel is required before any Woot permission request, public beta, alert expansion, affiliate, or advertising use. Do not treat incomplete telemetry alone as a blocker for ordinary reversible growth.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent and do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or launch state.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert permissions, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident procedures, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Continue only existing affiliate repair and measurement work. Validate destination integrity, registered tracking IDs, disclosures, click attribution, and rollback evidence using existing telemetry. Preserve the Amazon aggregate row as unattributed: 629 clicks, 28 ordered items, and $4.92 commission cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift, and do not requeue work.

Maintain private launch gates and continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked because fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results and all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Their compliance checks are unreachable, analytics are not configured, and audience, revenue, attribution, health, and launch readiness remain unknown. Continue only dated execution-owner and reachability evidence; make no DNS, credential, analytics, monetization, deployment, or launch-state changes.
